why: SSH setup scripts create folders, then check them (no check-then-create race), and every failure names its reason. On the paths these recordings took the new scripts answer as the old ones did (no output, the same status), so the commands the app sent are rewritten; recordings of failures (a release saying why) are rerecorded by 0002.

replace.old:
umask 077
owner=$(id -u) || exit 1
if test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin; then
  metadata() { stat -f '%u %Lp %l' "$1"; }
else
  metadata() { stat -c '%u %a %h' "$1"; }
fi
private_directory() {
  test ! -L "$1" && test -d "$1" || return 1
  set -- $(metadata "$1")
  test "$#" = 3 && test "$1" = "$owner" && test "$2" = 700
}
safe_file() {
  test ! -L "$1" && test -f "$1" || return 1
  set -- $(metadata "$1")
  test "$#" = 3 && test "$1" = "$owner" && test "$3" = 1 || return 1
  case "$2" in 600|700) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac
}
enter_private() {
  test -e "$1" || test -L "$1" || mkdir "$1" || return 1
  private_directory "$1" && cd -P "$1"
}
cd -P "$HOME" || exit 1
set -- $(metadata .)
test "$#" = 3 && test "$1" = "$owner" && test "$((0$2 & 022))" = 0 || exit 1
test ! -L .dispatch || exit 1
enter_private .dispatch || exit 1
replace.new:
umask 077
fail() {
  printf 'dispatch-setup: %s\n' "$*"
  printf 'dispatch-setup: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}
owner=$(id -u) || fail "cannot read the account id"
if test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin; then
  metadata() { stat -f '%u %Lp %l' "$1"; }
else
  metadata() { stat -c '%u %a %h' "$1"; }
fi
private_directory() {
  test ! -L "$1" && test -d "$1" || return 1
  set -- $(metadata "$1")
  test "$#" = 3 && test "$1" = "$owner" && test "$2" = 700
}
safe_file() {
  test ! -L "$1" && test -f "$1" || return 1
  set -- $(metadata "$1")
  test "$#" = 3 && test "$1" = "$owner" && test "$3" = 1 || return 1
  case "$2" in 600|700) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac
}
enter_private() {
  mkdir "$1" 2>/dev/null
  if ! private_directory "$1"; then
    if test -e "$1" || test -L "$1"; then fail "unsafe folder $1"; else fail "cannot create folder $1"; fi
  fi
  cd -P "$1" || fail "cannot enter folder $1"
}
cd -P "$HOME" || fail "no home folder"
set -- $(metadata .)
test "$#" = 3 && test "$1" = "$owner" && test "$((0$2 & 022))" = 0 || fail "home folder writable by others"
enter_private .dispatch

replace.old: enter_private bin && enter_private versions && enter_private '{{digest}}' || exit 1
replace.new:
enter_private bin && enter_private versions && enter_private '{{digest}}'
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "no sha256sum or shasum"

replace.old: test ! -e dispatch-helper && test ! -L dispatch-helper || safe_file dispatch-helper || exit 1
replace.new: test ! -e dispatch-helper && test ! -L dispatch-helper || safe_file dispatch-helper || fail "unsafe cached helper"
mkdir '{{staging}}' || fail "cannot create the upload folder"
chmod 700 '{{staging}}/dispatch-helper' || fail "cannot make the helper executable"

replace.old:
mv -f '{{staging}}/dispatch-helper' dispatch-helper || exit 1
safe_file dispatch-helper && test -x dispatch-helper && test "$(wc -c < dispatch-helper | tr -d ' ')" = '{{size}}' && test "$(checksum dispatch-helper)" = '{{digest}}'
replace.new:
mv -f '{{staging}}/dispatch-helper' dispatch-helper || fail "cannot install the helper"
safe_file dispatch-helper && test -x dispatch-helper && test "$(wc -c < dispatch-helper | tr -d ' ')" = '{{size}}' && test "$(checksum dispatch-helper)" = '{{digest}}' || fail "installed helper does not verify"

replace.old:
enter_private sessions || exit 1
enter_private '{{session}}' || exit 1
test ! -e ready && test ! -L ready || exit 1
(set -C; printf '%s\n' '.dispatch/bin/versions/{{digest}}/dispatch-helper' > ready.pending) || exit 1
mv -f ready.pending ready
replace.new:
enter_private sessions
enter_private '{{session}}'
test ! -e ready && test ! -L ready || fail "session already released"
(set -C; printf '%s\n' '.dispatch/bin/versions/{{digest}}/dispatch-helper' > "ready.$$") || fail "cannot write the ready file"
mv -f "ready.$$" ready || fail "cannot release the session"
